newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes softer after thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes softer after thin trade.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,500-1,505 per dollar, down from midday's 1,495-1,500 and the opening's 1,485-1,505 as foreign currency demand rose on the first working day after a long holiday, dealers said.

"The (interbank) market settled at lower levels for the lev after a rise in dollar demand from from large end clients thwarted a rise that seemed possible in the morning. Trade was generally quiet and in light volumes," one dealer said.

The lev closed at 1,480-1,490 per dollar on April 25, the last working day for the local market before an Orthodox Easter and Labour Day holidays from Monday through Thursday. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
